description_en: Deletes multiple media assets at a time. You can delete at most 20 media assets at a time. If MediaIds is specified, it is preferentially used. If MediaIds is empty, InputURLs must be specified
description_zh: 批量删除媒资信息，最多一次删20个。MediaIds不为空时，优先使用MediaIds。如果MediaIds为空，则InputURLs必须非空
name: DeleteMediaInfos

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the media asset that you want to delete from Intelligent Media Services (IMS).

Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

If you leave MediaIds empty, you must specify InputURLs
parameters.help_zh:
IMS 媒资ID
多个用英文逗号分隔。

若MediaIds 字段为空，则InputURLs字段必须不为空
parameters.name: media_ids

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the media asset that you want to delete. The file corresponding to the URL must be registered with IMS. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,). The following two formats are supported: http(s)://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4? OSS://example-bucket/example.mp4?
In this format, it is considered by default that the region of the OSS bucket in which the media asset resides is the same as the region in which IMS is activated
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的媒资在相应系统中的地址，该地址对应的文件需要先在IMS中注册，多个URL用英文逗号分隔。
支持两种格式
http(s)://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4?
OSS://example-bucket/example.mp4?  
此格式默认OSS region与服务接入区域一致
parameters.name: input_urls

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the physical file of the media asset.

If the media asset is stored in your own OSS bucket, you must authorize the service role AliyunICEDefaultRole in advance. For more information<props="china">, see Authorize IMS to delete recording files in OSS (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/user-guide/record?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i8#0737d9c437bmn)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除媒资的物理文件。

若媒资的存储地址是用户自有oss，需对服务角色AliyunICEDefaultRole提前进行授权<props="china">，具体操作请参见删除录制文件说明（OSS授权管理） (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/user-guide/record?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i8#0737d9c437bmn)</props>
parameters.name: delete_physical_files

ForbiddenList.description_en: The IDs or URLs of media assets that cannot be deleted. Generally, media assets cannot be deleted if you do not have the required permissions
ForbiddenList.description_zh: 不可删除的媒资ID或URL（与用户输入一致）列表。一般由于无权限导致

items.description_en: The ID or URL of the media asset that cannot be deleted
items.description_zh: 不可删除的媒资ID或URL（与用户输入一致）

IgnoredList.description_en: The IDs or URLs of ignored media assets. An error occurred while obtaining such media assets
IgnoredList.description_zh: 出现获取错误的ID或InputURL（与用户输入一致）列表

items.description_en: The ID or URL of the ignored media asset. An error occurred while obtaining the media asset
items.description_zh: 出现获取错误的ID或InputURL（与用户输入一致）
